forum.title: STM32CubeMX 6.18.1 released
forum.best_answer_content:
This is an announcement post, if you have any issue or feedback to report please use the main page:

[STM32CubeMX (MCUs) | STM32 MCUs Software development tools | Community](https://community.st.com/stm32cubemx-mcus-29)
forum.content_text:
**We are pleased to announce that the minor version 6.18.1 of STM32CubeMX is available.**

**What is new in 6.18.1:**

This release addresses and resolves the issues outlined below:

* **Download error for crdb.zip during update**

+ STM32CubeMX displays a download error pop-up during data updates.

***Note :****This issue is resolved for 6.18.1 and later versions. For the* earli*er versions customers                                        may refer to the following workaround already shared in the community:*

[*Workaround for file download error: crdb.zip (Problem during download) | Community*](https://community.st.com/stm32cubemx-mcus-29/workaround-for-file-download-error-crdb-zip-problem-during-download-166762)

* **Error occurred while importing .ioc file created with STM32CubeMX older than 6.18.0**

+ The “Continue and Migrate” features are not working properly for projects with PCC configured.

* **Issue when setting clock to 240Mhz in STM32H743 and STM32H753**

+ STM32CubeMX prevents the user from selecting 240 MHz, displaying the message: “240 MHz maximum frequency must be <= 225 MHz.”

**Fixed issues in 6.18.1:**

Refer to the STM32CubeMX online documentation: [here](https://dev.st.com/stm32cube-docs/stm32cubemx/6.18.1/en/docs/markup/CubeMX_RelaseNotes/CubeMX_Release_Fixed_In_This_Release.html)

**Known problems and limitations in 6.18.1:**

Refer to the STM32CubeMX online documentation: [here](https://dev.st.com/stm32cube-docs/stm32cubemx/6.18.1/en/docs/markup/CubeMX_RelaseNotes/CubeMX_Release_Notes_Limitation_toc.html)

**How to get STM32CubeMX 6.18.1:**

* Download STM32CubeMX from [here](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html)

* Or update your current installation of STM32CubeMX using: Help > Check for Updates
